description: This file defines API route handlers for suggestions in a FastAPI application. It includes endpoints for listing suggestions and generating a new suggestion, interacting with the database and external market data service.

methods.name: get_suggestions(db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of suggestions for the authenticated user.

methods.name: generate_suggestion(payload: SuggestionCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to generate a new suggestion using market data and save it.

calls: create_suggestion(db=db, user_id=current_user.id, symbol=payload.symbol, action=action, rationale=rationale, target_price=payload.target_price, market=payload.market)

ctags.name: generate_suggestion
ctags.pattern: /^def generate_suggestion(payload: SuggestionCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user=D/
